title: Exact all-Schmidt-spectrum certificate for one aligned rank-five support mechanism
statement: For any qutrit Schmidt vector and one off-diagonal Schmidt-basis product direction, every state on their span obeys the W3 entropy bound.

requires: One vector psi=sum_i sqrt(p_i)|ii> and one product basis vector |jk> with j != k; states supported on their two-dimensional span.
provides: The exact entropy bound for all nonnegative Schmidt weights on the specified support mechanism.
assumptions: Use homogeneous nonnegative coordinates and local unitary phase choices only; no nonunitary filtering as an entropy symmetry.
costs: Finite symbolic certificate; checker and generator are retained but not replayed during intake.
contract.obstruction: Does not cover arbitrary superposed product vectors or every rank-five kernel space.

evidence.status: Exact selected source bytes; internal acceptance applies only through a version-bound overlay.

body: The certificate reports the exact cleared-denominator identity and square a*b^2*t^2*x*z*(a*y-t)^2 plus a nonnegative remainder; the root receipt is tied to the checker source hash.

review.scope: All Schmidt weights for one Schmidt-aligned off-diagonal product basis vector only.
